newsitem.title: USA: Duff rates American Health Properties notes.
newsitem.headline: Duff rates American Health Properties notes.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Wednesday it assigned a triple-B-minus rating to the recent offer of $220 million of senior notes by American Health Properties Inc.

Duff said the rating is based on the stable cash flow generated by the company's 33 health care properties, its strong operating performance for the core portfiolio, minimal exposure to construction loans and conservative balance sheet.
The note offer includes $100 million of 7.05-percent senior notes due January 15, 2002 and $120 million of 7.5-percent senior notes due January 15, 2007, Duff said.
Proceeds from the offer will be used to refinance bank debt and prepay existing senior notes, Dufff said.
Americah Health owns acute care hospitals. Its shares were unchanged Wednesday afternoon at 25-1/8.
